snippet.title: The Wild Run
snippet.description:
30 second video of The Wild Run by Lochraleon on Itch!

In Amgora, where the rare gift of being a Beastborn allows a chosen few to bond with magnificent proto-beasts, lives Annhanna Ventress. Her sanctuary offers refuge to these incredible proto-beasts, often misunderstood and mistreated in the wider world. More than just a safe place, it's where proto-beasts find the Beastborn they're meant to be with. But Annhanna's heartfelt work is on the brink of collapse. A final, devastating notice has arrived from the bank ready to foreclose her property, threatening to destroy everything she's built.

Her only shot? The Wild Run. It's a legendary race that brings together the elite Beastborn and their bonded proto-beasts in a thrilling test of speed, stamina, and teamwork. The grand prize could save her, but the qualifying rounds are brutal, a wall no rookie racer has ever broken through. Now, Annhanna and her loyal proto-beast have to push beyond their limits, and go beyond expectations relying on their unique connection and her unwavering spirit to defy the odds. Can they possibly win the Wild Run and save her sanctuary before it's too late?
